licence.private: My own copy — not to be shared

view.title: Library
view.intro: Your own books, notes and documents, stored on this computer. Every search result shows exactly where it comes from.

filter.heading: All sources
filter.label: Filter sources
filter.empty: Nothing in your library yet. Add a PDF, EPUB, Word, Markdown or text file.

remove.label: Remove {{title}}
remove.message: Remove {{title}} from your library? Its text and Abiding Word’s copy of the file are deleted; your original file is not touched. Study notes that cite it keep a record of the citation.
remove.marks_one: Your mark in it (a highlight, note or bookmark) is removed with it.
remove.marks_other: Your {{count}} marks in it (highlights, notes and bookmarks) are removed with it.

add.title: Add to library
add.reading: Reading the file and finding its text…
add.intro: Choose a PDF, EPUB, Word (.docx), Markdown (.md) or text (.txt) file. Abiding Word keeps its own copy in your library and never changes your file. Scanned PDFs cannot be read yet.
add.duplicate: This file is already in your library as {{title}}.

reader.openFullTitle: Read this source at full width

pane.empty: No sources yet. Add books, articles and your own notes (PDF, EPUB, Word, Markdown or text); they stay on this computer.
pane.noSources: No source in your library is linked to this passage.
pane.locationsFailed: The other places could not be loaded. Try again.

citations.openTitle: Open this source at the cited place
citations.searchLabel: Search your library for the passage to cite
citations.searchPlaceholder: Search your library for the passage to cite
citations.replaceQuote: Also replace this quotation’s text with the cited passage
citations.useQuote: Also use the cited passage as this quotation’s text
citations.openFailed: This source could not be opened.
citations.unavailableTitle: Source not available on this computer. The citation has been kept.

original.renderFailed: The original could not be shown. You can still read the extracted text.
original.noNativeText: This page has no selectable text

contents.title: Contents
contents.generatedNote: Made from the headings found in this source. It is not part of the original.

formatted.failed: This book’s original view can’t be shown. Reading still works.
formatted.failedDocument: This document’s original view can’t be shown. Reading still works.
formatted.linkFailed: The link could not be opened.

find.label: Find in this source
find.failed: The search could not be completed. Try again.

marks.title: Marks
marks.unresolved: This place can no longer be found in the text.
marks.empty: No marks in this source yet. Select some text to highlight it or add a note.
marks.show: Show the marks in this source
marks.cannotPlace: These words cannot be marked here exactly. Select them in Reading to mark them.

copy.failed: The quotation could not be copied.

inquiry.title: Help with this passage
inquiry.includeStudyHint: Its passage and up to six of its notes are added to what is sent.
inquiry.noStudy: No Bible Study is open, so only the selected words are used.
inquiry.keepNote: Open a Bible Study to add notes to it.

compare.notAdded: Not added: this passage is already there, or three are chosen.
compare.needTwo: Choose at least two passages: select words in a source, then More actions → Add to comparison.

trash.label: Move {{title}} to Trash
trash.question: Move “{{title}}” to Trash?
trash.kept: Your marks in it, and the citations in your studies, stay with it and come back if you restore it.
trash.text_one: It leaves your library, the Sources pane and search. You can restore it from Trash (Settings → Sources) for {{count}} day; after that it is deleted for good.
trash.text_other: It leaves your library, the Sources pane and search. You can restore it from Trash (Settings → Sources) for {{count}} days; after that it is deleted for good.
trash.marks_one: Its {{count}} mark (a highlight, note or bookmark) is hidden while it is in Trash.
trash.marks_other: Its {{count}} marks (highlights, notes and bookmarks) are hidden while it is in Trash.

delete.question: Delete “{{title}}” permanently?
delete.text: Its text, your marks in it and Abiding Word’s copy of the file are deleted.
delete.kept: Citations in your studies keep a record of what they cited. Your original file is not touched.

filter.duplicates: Only files added more than once

manage.empty: No sources yet. Add your books, articles and notes to read them beside the Bible.
manage.noMatches: No sources match. Try other words or fewer filters.
manage.archiveEmpty: Nothing is archived. Archived sources stay searchable but leave your lists and the Sources pane.

done.untagged_one: The tag was removed from {{formatted}} source.
done.untagged_other: The tag was removed from {{formatted}} sources.

file.duplicatesText_other: Added {{formatted}} more times (find them with “Only files added more than once”).

extraction.extracted: Text read from the PDF’s text layer.

manage.collectHint: A source can be in several collections; its file is not copied or moved.
manage.collectionsText: Your own groups, inside one another if you like. Removing a collection keeps its sources.
manage.noTags: No tags yet. Add them to sources from the list above.
manage.removeCollectionText: The collection and those inside it go. Their sources stay in your library.
manage.removeTagText: It is taken off every source. The sources stay.
